sn35.7:0.3: The Internal as Impermanent in the Three Times
sn35.7:1.1: At Savatthi. “Bhikkhus, the eye is impermanent, both of the past and the future,
sn35.7:1.2: not to speak of the present.
sn35.7:1.3: Seeing thus, bhikkhus, the instructed noble disciple is indifferent towards the eye of the past;
sn35.7:1.4: he does not seek delight in the eye of the future;
sn35.7:1.5: and he is practising for revulsion towards the eye of the present, for its fading away and cessation.
sn35.7:1.14: The mind is impermanent, both of the past and the future,
sn35.7:1.15: not to speak of the present.
sn35.7:1.16: Seeing thus, bhikkhus, the instructed noble disciple is indifferent towards the mind of the past …
sn35.7:1.18: for its fading away and cessation.”
